value.rationale: For mobile/immobile intermittent search, decisions about whether a position reset should also refresh mobility can be made exactly without solving the spatial search problem. The active-start invariance is counterintuitive; the stationary-initial refresh benefit is a strictly decreasing universal rational law in the refresh probability across arbitrary active Markov dynamics. This is a structural protocol-selection theorem rather than a mere numerical evaluation of a pre-specified model.
